WITH scored AS (
  SELECT
    u.user_id AS user_id,
    i.item_id AS item_id,
    (u.e1*i.e1 + u.e2*i.e2 + u.e3*i.e3 + u.e4*i.e4
     + u.e5*i.e5 + u.e6*i.e6 + u.e7*i.e7 + u.e8*i.e8) AS score
  FROM hive.mlpabf5af7f_featurestore.user_embeddings_1 u
  CROSS JOIN hive.mlpabf5af7f_featurestore.item_embeddings_1 i
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM hive.mlpabf5af7f_featurestore.interactions_1 x
    WHERE x.user_id = u.user_id AND x.item_id = i.item_id
  )
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, item_id, score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY score DESC, item_id ASC) AS rnk
  FROM scored
)
SELECT user_id || '#' || CAST(rnk AS varchar) AS rec_id,
       user_id, rnk AS rank, item_id
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5
ORDER BY user_id, rank
EOF
